summary.text: Jeremy Wooldridge represents District 1 in the Arkansas House of Representatives, which includes all of Clay County and parts of Greene and Randolph counties, and is serving his second term.

paragraphs.text: Wooldridge is chief executive officer of Crowley's Ridge Development Council and previously served as Justice of the Peace for Greene County District 10.
He has a bachelor's degree in business administration and a master's degree in social work from Arkansas State University and lives in Marmaduke.
